name: David Kessler
reason: His work is almost entirely grief support, which the brief treats as condition framing: grief.com is a help-for-grief site with grief groups, professional grief training and a counsellor directory, his YouTube is grief-led interviews ('grief expert ... on loss of a parent, death of a child, infertility, addiction'), and his Commune course is framed around trauma and grief. Only two books stand clearly outside that framing (Visions, Trips, and Crowded Rooms; Life Lessons with Elisabeth Kubler-Ross), which is too thin.
